verdict.rationale: Portability across edge runtimes is a fair question for a cloud deployment platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents support for standard runtime APIs or code that runs unmodified across multiple edge platforms. Generic claims like "connect your repo" and "run your application closer to where your users are" are adjacent and do not address runtime-API portability or lock-in.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write code against standard runtime APIs so it runs unmodified across multiple edge platforms instead of being locked into proprietary storage/runtime APIs
